metadata.source: OWASP Testing Guide, OWASP SSRF Prevention Cheat Sheet

description: SSRF occurs when web app fetches remote resource without validating user-supplied URL, allowing attacker to make requests to internal systems.

methodology.recon: Identify inputs that fetch URLs: image URL, webhook URL, file import, etc.
testing: Test with http://127.0.0.1, http://localhost, http://[::1], http://internal
Test with http://169.254.169.254 for cloud metadata (requires approval, high-impact)
Use Burp Collaborator or similar for out-of-band detection (with approval)
methodology.evidence: Request to internal URL returns internal data or time delay, tool output
methodology.verification: Reproduce with internal URL, check if response contains internal data, bypass via encoding, 0.0.0.0, etc.

severity.critical: SSRF to cloud metadata or internal admin, RCE

remediation: Validate URLs, allow list, deny list for private IPs, disable unnecessary URL schemas
safety: Cloud metadata probing requires Operator approval, high-impact, no destructive actions
